arms.method_patch: LLM returns only the diagnosed _stage_* method; the harness splices it in and AST-locks every other method (existing selective.py --resume-adapter path).
arms.module_rewrite: LLM returns a complete module under the same stage contract with the same measured evidence; any stage method may change; semantically unchanged modules are rejected.

shared_controls: same failed candidate bytes and same replay before repair
same repair localization and measured state feedback
same environment seed, model, temperature, token limit, and max cycles
paired LLM sampling seeds across arms
official success only; failed runs stay in the denominator
note: Resume-based repair evidence. Never merge these runs into from-scratch generation comparisons.
